description: This file defines the class AOBH_BusinessHours, which manages business hours data, including retrieval, calculation of hours between dates, and checking if a given date-time falls within business hours.

classes.name: AOBH_BusinessHours
classes.description: Represents business hours for a specific module, provides methods for retrieving and manipulating business hour data, and calculating hours between dates within business hours.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates whether this bean implements a specific interface (returns false in this case).

methods.name: areBusinessHoursSet
methods.description: Checks if the business hours set is initialized and counts the total number of business hours entries.

methods.name: getBusinessHoursForDay
methods.description: Retrieves the list of business hours entries for a specific day, caching the results.

methods.name: getOrCreate
methods.description: Returns an existing business hours entry for a specific day or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: insideThisBusinessHour
methods.description: Determines if a given DateTime falls within this business hour's open time and close time, considering the open status.

methods.name: diffBusinessHours
methods.description: Calculates the number of business hours between two DateTime instances.

methods.name: addBusinessHours
methods.description: Adds a specified number of business hours to a DateTime object, returning the adjusted DateTime.

methods.name: insideAnyBusinessHours
methods.description: Checks if a given DateTime falls within any of the business hours entries for that day.
